# Migration guidance compatibility pointer

This repository is a TMDB-backed movie app, not an e-commerce project. For
current product requirements, setup instructions, and migration conventions,
follow [`../melofix-nextapp/SKILL.md`](../melofix-nextapp/SKILL.md). The
canonical skill is specific to Melofix and replaces the old e-commerce
guidance.
